name.description: Patient's full name. Source: provided by patient/intake form. Used as the greeting name in the generated email (e.g., 'Dear <name>,'). Trim whitespace.

age.description: Patient's age in years. Positive whole number. Source: provided by patient/intake form.

gender.description: Patient's gender as reported (e.g., Male, Female, Other, Prefer not to say). Source: provided by patient/intake form. Do not infer if not given.

symptoms.description: Description of the symptoms the patient is experiencing, free text, may list multiple symptoms separated by commas. Source: provided by patient/intake form.

symptomsDuration.description: How long the patient has been experiencing the symptoms (e.g., '3 days', '2 weeks'). Source: provided by patient/intake form.

severity.description: Patient- or staff-reported severity level of the symptoms (e.g., Mild, Moderate, Severe). Source: provided by patient/intake form. Use exactly as given; do not upgrade or downgrade the level.

action.description: The recommended next action or instruction to communicate to the patient (e.g., 'Schedule a follow-up appointment', 'Visit the ER immediately', 'Continue monitoring at home'). Source: provided by healthcare staff/intake form. Use exactly as given; do not invent a different action.

Email_Body.description: The complete, ready-to-send email as a single plain-text block. Must start with a greeting line 'Dear {{input.name}},'. Then, on its own new line, each required detail must appear as 'Label: value' — specifically Age:, Gender:, Symptoms:, Symptom Duration:, Severity:, each from the matching input field, one per line with a line break (\n) after every line (never combined on the same line). Then a blank line, followed by a 'Recommended Action:' line with the value from {{input.action}}. End with a polite closing line 'Best regards,' followed by the fixed sign-off 'Patient Assistance System' on the next line. Use \n for every line break; plain text only, no Markdown bold, no HTML tags, no extra commentary outside the email itself.
